canned_tomato|canned_tuna_meat|eggs|milk.title: One-Pan Pantry Tuna Arrabbiata Pasta
steps: Boil pasta or noodles in salted water until al dente, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.
Warm oil in a skillet, pour in canned tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Flake drained canned tuna or meat into the simmering tomato sauce.
Toss drained pasta into the skillet with reserved water and serve hot.
canned_tomato|canned_tuna_meat|eggs|milk.zero_waste_tip: Rinse the tomato can with 2 tablespoons of pasta water to capture all remaining sauce.

canned_tomato|canned_tuna_meat|eggs|milk.title: Farmhouse Fridge Egg, Dairy & Tuna Scramble
steps: Whisk eggs with a splash of milk or dairy and a pinch of salt.
Warm drained canned tuna or meat in a lightly oiled non-stick pan for 2 minutes.
Pour whisked eggs over the protein and fold gently over medium-low heat until softly set.
Top with any remaining cheese or diced vegetables and serve immediately.
canned_tomato|canned_tuna_meat|eggs|milk.zero_waste_tip: Use any small leftover dairy splashes at the bottom of the carton to make eggs fluffier.

canned_tomato|canned_tuna_meat|eggs|milk.title: Hearty Savory Grain, Tomato & Protein Bowl
steps: Simmer grains or oats with water and a spoonful of canned tomatoes for a savory base.
Warm canned tuna or meat in a small pan with condiments and black pepper.
Spoon the savory tomato grains into a bowl and top with the seasoned protein.
Finish with a pan-fried egg or fresh chopped produce on top.
canned_tomato|canned_tuna_meat|eggs|milk.zero_waste_tip: Savory oatmeal and rice bowls rescue single-serving grain leftovers in under 15 minutes.

canned_tomato|eggs|pasta_noodles.title: Rustic Skillet Tomato & Poached Eggs (Shakshuka)
steps: Saute chopped fresh produce in a skillet with oil until softened.
Pour in canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Make gentle wells in the tomato sauce and crack eggs directly into each well.
Cover skillet and cook on low for 4 to 5 minutes until egg whites set.
canned_tomato|eggs|pasta_noodles.zero_waste_tip: Serve over toasted bread ends or leftover cooked grains to soak up every drop of sauce.

Saute diced fresh produce (onions, tomatoes, or greens) in oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
